results.title: Selma
results.overview: Neslihan, an unsuccessful actress, and her social media influencer friends break into the home of Selma—a woman suffering from Alzheimer’s—to secretly live-stream her for profit. As their viewership surges, the house begins to reveal its terrifying secrets, and the young women find themselves trapped in a lethal Dark Web show. Now, Neslihan must decide just how far she is willing to go to escape poverty and achieve fame.

results.title: Cocorico 2
results.overview: DNA tests before Alice and François's wedding reveal their fathers - an aristocrat and car dealer - aren't as French as they thought.

results.title: Kijsada Paradise
results.original_title: กฤษดา พาราไดซ์
results.overview: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

results.title: Ebb Tide
results.overview: The waters of the Lagoon hide stories, mysteries and torments. They unveil life and hide death to the taste of the tides. A man lives tortured by memories. And when life dresses itself in anguish without answers, the water may unveil them.

results.title: Marrow
results.overview: A Vodcast host declining in popularity receives the career opportunity of a lifetime when a mysterious stranger invites her into its dangerous world.

results.title: KD – The Devil
results.overview: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

results.title: Check Out Sekarang, Pay Later (Caper)
results.overview: Tina, a former beauty queen, teams up with fellow victim Mail to expose a powerful illegal loan network while struggling to repay her debts and support her younger brother.

results.title: Stardust
results.overview: Autumn is haunted by vivid dreams of a man, Jo. As Autumn’s waking life becomes a blur, she faces hard truths about her reality.

results.title: Argentina Stone
results.overview: Argentina Stone explores how The Rolling Stones inspired one of the most powerful urban subcultures in Latin America. Through archival footage and testimonies from key figures of Argentine rock, the film traces the birth, rise, and legacy of the rolinga movement - a tribe that transformed admiration for a band into a way of life.

results.title: Once More
results.overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

results.title: Overt Listening
results.overview: Hong Kong–born artist Tiffany Sia confronts the Cold War legacy of China in this landscape film shot amidst the serene environs of Taiwan’s Kinmen archipelago. On this stretch of land only 1,800 meters from the coast of China, deserted beaches and abandoned military bunkers and training facilities harbor echoes of past conflict, such as the 1949 Battle of Guningtou, in which Taiwan defeated the Chinese Communist Party and maintained control of the land.

results.title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
results.original_title: cocoon～ある夏の少女たちより～
results.overview: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

results.title: TÀI
results.overview: Tài is suddenly pulled into a dangerous spiral after becoming trapped under a massive debt. Pushed to the brink, he is forced into a series of reckless choices that soon place his family under threat. Behind his desperate actions lies a deep obsession with protecting and repaying the mother he loves at any cost. As the line between right and wrong grows increasingly blurred, Tài must confront the most difficult question of his life: can filial devotion justify the path he has chosen?

results.title: Sengkolo: Petaka Satu Suro
results.overview: The village terror grew increasingly tense due to the many strange occurrences occurring in the village, especially since many of the victims were pregnant women. The succession of terrifying and disturbing incidents angered the villagers, angering them. The terrifying terrors and apparitions intensified as the night of Suro approached.

results.title: Rose of Nevada
results.overview: When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. Young father Nick and enigmatic newcomer Liam join captain Murgey, and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss – they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew.

results.title: Slanted
results.overview: An insecure Chinese-American teenager undergoes experimental surgery to appear white, hoping to secure the prom queen title and peer acceptance.

results.title: Deathgasm II: Goremageddon
results.overview: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.

results.title: Night Patrol
results.overview: An L.A. cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger.

results.title: Fokus
results.overview: Jaana, a top coach at the elite club Fokus, suffers a medical emergency under mysterious circumstances, leaving Olympic hopeful Tove in need of a new coach. When former star skater Miina returns to the club, a quest for revenge ignites a volatile power struggle in which no one’s reputation is safe.  *Fokus* is an intense miniseries set in the glittering yet harsh world of figure skating.
